Level 6: Grand Bazaar

Anqi wants a real Bellamore handbag… but the Grand Bazaar is full of fakes! Explore, ask the shopkeepers for clues and find the real one.

Joystick / arrows: walk · ACTION: talk & enter · NOTES: Anqi’s notes

Level 6 complete!

A real Bellamore for a real love. Next stop: sunset at the Maiden’s Tower…

Level 7: Leander’s Light

In the dream, Mirza is Leander and Anqi is Hero. Swim across the sea to Hero’s light! The surface current pushes you back, the deep current carries you forward – but watch your oxygen.

Joystick: swim · DASH: burst of speed · surface to breathe

Level 7 complete!

The legend has a new ending – and you have a gull named Simit. Next stop: coffee in Cihangir…

Level 8: Cihangir Cats

Paşa the street cat stole Anqi’s charm! Win over all six cats of Cihangir – every one of them needs a different trick.

◀ ▶ walk · ACTION talk & interact · follow the yellow arrow

Level 8 complete!

Six new friends, and the charm is back. But the clouds over the Bosphorus look dark…

Level 9: Wet Istanbul

Walk Anqi to Galata through the pouring rain under a tiny umbrella. Keep her dry!

◀ ▶ walk · right buttons tilt the umbrella into the rain · awnings are checkpoints

Level 9 complete!

Level 10: Galata Tower

Anqi wants the best view in Istanbul! Carry her up Galata Tower – but watch out for seagulls, crumbling stones, wind and aunties shaking rugs out of their windows!

Level 10 complete!

The best view in Istanbul… but tomorrow, Anqi flies home.
